# 小红书 Web 逆向分析

## 介绍

本文主要讲解了小红书Web端逆向的过程，包含Java逆向和JS逆向，JAva逆向主要是在JS逆向基础上转换的，逆向分析的必要内容如下：

1.Auth
2.X-S、X-T
3.X-sign
4.X-Cos-Security-Token
5.videoId

## js逆向分析

### 一、Authorization 分析流程

    package com.yichuang.media.core.xhs;
    
    import com.yichuang.common.utils.HmacSHA1Utils;
    import com.yichuang.common.utils.Md5Util;
    import com.yichuang.common.utils.SHA1Utils;
    import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
    import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
    
    import java.io.UnsupportedEncodingException;
    import java.net.URLEncoder;
    import java.util.*;
    
    /**
     * <p></p>
     *
     * @author: daizhao 10:59 2024/3/5 0005
     */
    @Slf4j
    public class XhsAuth {
    
        /** 固定盐值 */
        private final static String GR = "A4NjFqYu5wPHsO0XTdDgMa2r1ZQocVte9UJBvk6/7=yRnhISGKblCWi+LpfE8xzm3";
    
        /**
         * URLEncoder.encode 在 Java 中将空格字符编码为 +，这是符合 URL 编码标准的。
         * 然而，在 JavaScript 的 encodeURIComponent 函数中，空格字符被编码为 %20。这种差异源于不同的规范和历史原因
         * eg:
         *           String testString = "Hello! This is a test string with special chars: !'()*";
         *           String encodedString = getEncodeURIComponent(testString);
         *           System.out.println(encodedString);
         * @param str
         * @return
         * @throws UnsupportedEncodingException
         */
        public static String getEncodeURIComponent(String str) throws UnsupportedEncodingException {
            String encoded = URLEncoder.encode(str);
            // 将空格的编码从 '+' 替换为 '%20'
            encoded = encoded.replace("+", "%20");
            // 由于URLEncoder.encode已经对大部分特殊字符进行了编码，我们只需要额外处理那些它未处理的字符
            encoded = encoded.replace(" ","%20").replace("!", "%21").replace("'", "%27").replace("(", "%28").replace(")", "%29").replace("*", "%2A");
            return encoded;
        }
    
        /**
         * 提取对象的属性名（或键名）并进行排序, 依据toLowerCase 来判断是否转换小写
         * @param objectMap
         * @param toLowerCase
         * @return
         */
        public static List<String> getSortedKeys(Map<String, Object> objectMap, boolean toLowerCase) throws UnsupportedEncodingException {
            List<String> keys = new ArrayList<>(objectMap.keySet());
            for (int i = 0; i < keys.size(); i++) {
                String encodeStr = getEncodeURIComponent(keys.get(i));
                String key = toLowerCase ? encodeStr.toLowerCase(): encodeStr;
                keys.set(i, key);
            }
            Collections.sort(keys, String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER);
            return keys;
        }
    
        // 将对象转换为查询字符串
        public static String obj2str(Map<String, Object> obj, boolean toLowerCase) throws UnsupportedEncodingException {
            List<String> pairs = new ArrayList<>();
    
            // 遍历对象的所有属性
            for (Map.Entry<String, Object> entry : obj.entrySet()) {
                String key = entry.getKey();
                Object value = entry.getValue();
    
                // key, 如果需要将键转换为小写
                key = toLowerCase ? getEncodeURIComponent(key).toLowerCase() : getEncodeURIComponent(key);
    
                // value, 如果值为null则将其视为空字符串
                String valStr = (value != null) ? value.toString() : "";
                valStr = getEncodeURIComponent(valStr);
    
                // 添加“键=值”对到列表中
                pairs.add(key + "=" + valStr);
            }
    
            // 使用&符号连接所有对并返回结果字符串
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            for (int i = 0; i < pairs.size(); i++) {
                if (i > 0) {
                    sb.append("&");
                }
                sb.append(pairs.get(i));
            }
            return sb.toString();
        }
    
        public static String getAuth(Map<String, Object> params) throws Exception {
            String secretId = (String) params.getOrDefault("SecretId", "null");
            String secretKey = (String) params.getOrDefault("SecretKey", "null");
            String method = ((String) params.getOrDefault("method", params.getOrDefault("Method", "get"))).toLowerCase();
            Map<String, Object> headers = (Map<String, Object>) params.getOrDefault("Headers", params.getOrDefault("headers", new HashMap<>()));
            Map<String, Object> query = (Map<String, Object>) params.getOrDefault("Query", params.getOrDefault("params", new HashMap<>()));
            String pathname = (String) params.getOrDefault("Pathname", params.getOrDefault("pathname", ""));
            Boolean forceSignHost = (Boolean) params.getOrDefault("ForceSignHost", false);
            Object bucket = params.getOrDefault("Bucket", null);
            Object region = params.getOrDefault("Region", null);
            boolean UseRawKey = (boolean)params.getOrDefault("UseRawKey", false);
            String Key = (String) params.getOrDefault("Key", "");
            Integer expires = (Integer) params.getOrDefault("Expires", params.getOrDefault("expires", 900));
            if (secretId.isEmpty()) {
                throw new Exception("missing param SecretId");
            }
            if (secretKey.isEmpty()) {
                throw new Exception("missing param SecretKey");
            }
            String o = params.get("KeyTime").toString();
            String m = o;
            String v = o;
            Map<String, Object> u = headers;
            Map<String, Object> s = query;
            String b = StringUtils.join(getSortedKeys(headers, true), ";").toLowerCase();
    
            String w = StringUtils.join(getSortedKeys(s, true), ";").toLowerCase();
            String n = secretKey;
            String T = HmacSHA1Utils.getHmacSHA1(v, n);
            String a = method;
            String c = Key;
            String t;
            if (UseRawKey) {
                t = pathname != null ? pathname : ("/" + c);
            } else {
                t = pathname != null ? pathname : c;
                if (!t.startsWith("/")) {
                    t = "/" + t;
                }
            }
            String S = StringUtils.join(new String[]{a, t, obj2str(s, true), obj2str(u, true), ""}, "\n");
            log.info("##S=\n{}", S);
            String E = StringUtils.join(new String[]{"sha1", m, SHA1Utils.getSHA1Str(S), ""}, "\n");
            String signature = HmacSHA1Utils.getHmacSHA1(E, T);
            String authString = String.format(
                    "q-sign-algorithm=sha1&q-ak=%s&q-sign-time=%s&q-key-time=%s&q-header-list=%s&q-url-param-list=%s&q-signature=%s",
                    "null",
                    m,
                    v,
                    b,
                    w,
                    signature
            );
    
            return authString;
        }
    
        /**
         * 计算小红书 X-S
         * 是由 时间戳+test+请求路径+请求体（json字符串） 经过md5 加密后字符串 在调用如下方法进行盐值位移得出的结果
         * 备注：X-T 就是当前的时间戳
         * @param e
         * @return
         */
        public static String xS(String e){
            int f = 0;
            int a, s, u, c, l, d, p;
            String i = "";
            for(; f<e.length(); ){
                a = e.charAt(f++);
                try{
                    s = e.charAt(f++);
                }catch (Exception err){
                    s = 0;
                }
                try{
                    u = e.charAt(f++);
                }catch (Exception err){
                    u = 0;
                }
                c = a >> 2;
                l = ((a & 3) << 4) | (s>> 4);
                d = ((15 & s) << 2) | (u>>6);
                p = u & 63;
                if(s == 0){
                    d = p = 64;
                }else if(u == 0){
                    p = 64;
                }
                i = i + GR.charAt(c) + GR.charAt(l) + GR.charAt(d) + GR.charAt(p);
                //System.out.println("f=" + f + ",a=" + a + ",s=" + s + ",u=" + u + ",c=" + c + ",l=" + l + ",d=" + d + ",p=" + p + ",i=" + i);
            }
            log.info("##xs签名=\n{}", i);
            return i;
        }
    
        public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
            // 测试函数
    //        String testString = "Hello! This is a test string with special chars: !'()*";
    //        String encodedString = getEncodeURIComponent(testString);
    //        System.out.println(encodedString);
            Map<String, Object> e = new HashMap<>();
            e.put("Expires", null); // 使用null表示没有值
            e.put("ForceSignHost", true);
    
            // 创建一个HashMap来表示Headers
            Map<String, Integer> headers = new HashMap<>();
            headers.put("Content-Length", 2110223);
            e.put("Headers", headers); // 将Headers映射添加到e中
    
            e.put("KeyTime", "1709523720;1709530870");
            e.put("Method", "PUT");
            e.put("Pathname", "/spectrum/f2RK_yF8TC6Num5DtvUiB9v6I87nGDkm1BO3X2bfHQVqiQI");
            e.put("Query", new HashMap<>()); // 使用空的HashMap来表示Query参数（如果没有查询参数的话）
            e.put("SecretId", "null"); // 注意：这里保留了字符串"null"，但可能需要根据实际情况替换为实际的null或有效值
            e.put("SecretKey", "null"); // 同上，可能需要替换为实际的密钥值或null（如果不需要的话）
            e.put("SystemClockOffset", 0);
            e.put("UseRawKey", false);
    
            System.out.println("\n##==计算签名==##\n" + getAuth(e));
    
    
            String md5Hex = Md5Util.md5("1709795208303test/fe_api/burdock/v2/note/query_transcode{\"videoId\":\"136771795787720032\"}");
            System.out.println("##==md5Hex==##\n" + md5Hex);
    
            System.out.println("##==X-S签名==##\n" + xS(md5Hex));
    
        }
    }

        /**
